review_method: Two Codex reviewers actually viewed all 22 contact sheets; every exact source file/preview is independently bound. Format/keywords/source name did not constitute a verdict.
review_limits: Covers the selected raster-only and raster-containing records from the first incomplete Togo collection, not later continuation files or every pure-vector record.
Photograph/micrograph verdicts are actual visual-medium judgments; upstream photographic provenance is not independently established.
Ambiguous photo-versus-rendering, low-resolution or finished-information-product cases remain scope_pending; no automatic photography classification from PNG.
Illustration verdict concerns usable visual media scope only, not exact anatomy/species, native editability, source rights or final release acceptance.
Keep allowed sibling variants: tile 723 SVG contains photographic paper/background while tile 724 PNG is an independently reviewed clean drawing.
Labels/signatures do not mechanically disqualify an object or experimental scene. Finished text/code/table/research-figure candidates require a separate content-scope review.
